_comment: vugg-canary config. vuggPath is resolved relative to this repo root. Since 2026-10-28 (boss) it is the canary's own vugg checkout, a detached worktree of the vugg repo (README: The target). Before every full run `follow` moves it to the newest <remote>/<branch>; a run that sweeps then installs (npm ci, only when package-lock.json changed) and compiles dist/ from source. Before that, vuggPath was the vugg checkout people work in, which sat on a September branch while main moved on.
_seeds_comment: 55 since 2026-11-03: the first 64-seed sweep (2026-11-02) took 5 h 48 min, 5.3 min per seed, and overran the 04:00–09:00 window by 48 min, so the count came down to the ~55 that status said fit (the boss's standing rule: on an overrun, bring the seeds down and say so). It was 64 for that one night (the boss's 2026-10-28 instruction: go back up once the wall-dissolution proxy fix is in main), 40 from 2026-10-31 and 30 from 2026-10-28, down from 200: a 200-seed sweep took 31 h at v285 (9.3 min per seed across 41 scenarios; supergene_oxidation, tn457_barite_pulses, reactive_wall and bisbee were 74% of it), so it could not finish in a night. The fix (vugg PR #41) reached main as e86ba58a. Three sweeps of that one commit measured 7.2 min per seed (2026-10-29, 30 seeds), 4.6 (2026-11-01, 40 seeds) and 5.3 (2026-11-02, 64 seeds): the night's load, not the code, sets the rate. `npm run status` prints '⚑ seeds: ~N fit 04:00–09:00 ... go back up' when a quarter more seeds fit, and flags a sweep that overruns the night. Take the most seeds that fit and move diffThreshold.absPts with them (3 standard errors: 300*sqrt(0.5/N), i.e. 15 at 200, 27 at 64, 29 at 55, 30 at 50, 34 at 40, 39 at 30). status.mjs flags an absPts that doesn't fit the seed count.
_autoPush_comment: After each sweep, commit logs/<date> (the spine only — .gitignore filters the heavy regenerable tiers) and push to origin (Syntaxswine) for the off-machine longitudinal record. Set false to keep the spine local-only. A push failure is non-fatal: the sweep always saves locally first.

diffThreshold._comment: Alarm if a species' spawn-% moves beyond absPts (boss decision 3), OR a rare-but-present species moves by relMult-fold (fresh-eyes addendum — catches relative swings the absolute gate misses on low-frequency phases). absPts is 3 standard errors for the seed count: 15 at 200 seeds, 39 at 30 (the boss's 2026-10-28 value), 34 at 40 (2026-10-31), 27 at 64 (2026-11-02), 29 at 55 (2026-11-03). The 3-seed rare-species floor is also the boss's 2026-10-28 value. The floor (rel_move and appeared/disappeared) is max(minPctForRel, 100*minSeedsForRel/N) of the smaller sweep: 4.7% at 64 seeds, 5.5% at 55, 7.5% at 40, 10% at 30, back to 2% at 200. When two sweeps differ in seed count the larger is cut back to the smaller's seeds before the diff (from its local seeds.json), so the extra seeds' luck can't alarm on identical code. On the 10-26 sweep's own seeds, disjoint 30-seed blocks of one engine raise 0.8 false alarms per pair at 39 pts / 3 seeds (mostly rel_move) vs 4.4 at 15 pts / 2%.
